title: Login Outage Retrospective
decisions: Add an alert when token refresh errors exceed 2% for five minutes
Rotate signing keys with a 24-hour overlap window

action_items.task: Create the token refresh error-rate alert
Change key rotation to keep the old signing key valid for 24 hours

transcript:
Lena Fischer: On Monday, logins failed for 47 minutes. The OAuth2 signing key rotated, and mobile clients holding tokens signed by the old key could not refresh.
Marcus Bell: Rotation removed the old key immediately. We should keep the old key valid for an overlap window, say 24 hours.
Sam Okafor: We also found out from customers, not from monitoring. Token refresh errors jumped to 30% and nothing paged.
Lena Fischer: I'll add an alert when the refresh error rate stays above 2% for five minutes.
Marcus Bell: I'll change the rotation job to keep the previous key for 24 hours.
Sam Okafor: I'll write the public incident summary today. Customers asked for it.
